brief.name: amazon_sword_right
brief.description:
Render ONE RIGHT view of the EXACT SAME object in the supplied front artwork, not a new similar design. Subject: Echinodorus grisebachii. Rooted basal crown with ten broad lanceolate sword leaves, vivid but restrained medium green, clear longitudinal midrib and parallel arching secondary veins. Longer inner leaves upright, older outer leaves spread in a full three-dimensional rosette. Blades 18-29 cm including petiole, width 3-5 cm. Smooth entire edges, no fern leaflets or strong corrugation, no horizontal rhizome.
Match the supplied approved aquarium pixel illustration finish: fine deliberate crisp pixel clusters, broad coherent painted color masses, natural material planes, subtle detailed highlights and restrained color. Camera is exactly at the RIGHT END, looking along -X. Orthographic perpendicular end elevation. Horizontal image axis is front/back Z depth, vertical is Y height. The long X axis points straight at the viewer and disappears in projection: horizontal long limbs become short broken end faces. Do NOT show the long front facade again. Match FRONT height and branch elevations.
Keep every source branch, knot, root foot, leaf identity, stone shoulder and fracture as the same physical object seen from the new camera. Match the source's painted material, color palette and fine pixel finish exactly. Infer hidden surfaces consistently, no new branches or decorative details. This single full-resolution image is a camera-specific material donor and form reference. One complete subject only; no labels, dimensions, inset, extra view or diagram.

brief.name: amazon_sword_leaves
brief.description:
Create a precise PART SHEET of SIX individually isolated full leaves from the EXACT SAME Echinodorus grisebachii. Rooted basal crown with ten broad lanceolate sword leaves, vivid but restrained medium green, clear longitudinal midrib and parallel arching secondary veins. Longer inner leaves upright, older outer leaves spread in a full three-dimensional rosette. Blades 18-29 cm including petiole, width 3-5 cm. Smooth entire edges, no fern leaflets or strong corrugation, no horizontal rhizome. in the source artwork.
Match its original fine naturalistic PIXEL ART finish, palette, specific leaf widths, venation, wrinkles and material. White background, no shadow or scenery.
Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, ONE COMPLETE LEAF including its petiole/basal strip in each cell. Stems at BOTTOM, tips at TOP. All six connected leaves fully inside their cells with generous white gaps, no overlap or grid lines, no text, no roots or whole plant. Six different natural sizes and bends, not six copies: large mature blade, smaller mature blade, younger upright blade, gently cupped blade, sideways curled blade, unfolding young blade. Keep narrow ribbon species genuinely narrow and broad ovate species genuinely broad. Use only variations appropriate to this species; do not turn grass into a fern or add leaflets. This is a dedicated high-resolution leaf sheet only, not packed alongside other views. Its exact original painted silhouettes will become individually shaped 3D leaf shells.

stages.notes: Pure-white validate must pass before trim/matte.
